input.quote: ARTICLE IV TERM I Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the \"Initial Period\").
input.rationale: Article IV commits the Licensee to a 36-month Initial Period (renewable for seven years at the Licensor's option) with no right for the Licensee to terminate for convenience. The only exit routes in the Agreement are Licensor-side or fault/insolvency-based: Licensor may terminate immediately on any Licensee breach (p0049), Licensor may terminate on Licensee wind-up (p0137), termination is automatic on a Change of Control of Licensee (p0134), and Article XIX permits insolvency termination only. The absence of any Customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months is a deviation under T4C (missing behaviour). Favourably, the Licensor also has no convenience right, so the redline adds a 30-day Licensee convenience exit with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and expressly confirms no reciprocal at-will Licensor right during the committed term, reaching the preferred position with a single inserted paragraph.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; confirm Licensor has no convenience right during the Initial Period
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The 36-month Initial Period gives us no way out absent Licensor breach, so we have added a convenience exit on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and confirmed the Licensor has no reciprocal at-will right mid-term. If helpful, we can move to 60-90 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.

ops.text: IV Termination for Convenience. Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, without penalty, early-termination charge or other liability, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee any prepaid fees covering the period after the effective date of termination on a pro-rata basis. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience or without cause during the Initial Period or any extension thereof.
